title: I KNOW WHAT I WANT
description: I spent my time on what I wanted.

panel-001.alt: Cover artwork showing HOGIRL in a school uniform.

panel-002.alt: HOGIRL studies at a desk in a classroom.

captions.text: I spent my time on what I wanted.
What I wanted was always clearer than what I was supposed to do.

panel-003.alt: HOGIRL writes in an open workbook at a desk.

captions.text: I was picky, even about what I studied.

panel-004.alt: HOGIRL sits at a desk with open books.

panel-005.alt: HOGIRL leaves a school building at sunset.

panel-006.alt: HOGIRL walks past language academy signs in the evening.

captions.text: Beyond school was a bigger world,
full of things I wanted to learn.
I found something I wanted to go after.

panel-008.alt: HOGIRL wears a cabin crew uniform beside an airport window.

panel-009.alt: HOGIRL looks at a cabin crew image at a desk.

panel-010.alt: HOGIRL writes at a desk in a darkened classroom.

panel-011.alt: Several scenes show HOGIRL studying and running.

panel-012.alt: HOGIRL stands near buses with a large bag.

panel-013.alt: The Seoul Station sign above a building entrance.

panel-014.alt: HOGIRL stands beside a small airplane and an airport control tower.

captions.text: I didn’t know which path was mine yet.

panel-015.alt: HOGIRL walks beside a small airplane and an airport control tower.

captions.text: But I knew what I wanted to try next.

panel-016.alt: HOGIRL knocks on a partly open door.
